مُرَجَّبٌ Honoured, or magnified: (S:) or revered, venerated, regarded with awe, and honoured, or magnified; (A;) as also ↓ مَرْجُوبٌ (S.) ―
-b2- The saying of Hobáb Ibn-El-Mundhir أَنَا عُذَيْقُهَا المُرَجَّبُ means I am their propped little palm-tree loaded with fruit; (S, * TA;) i. e. I have a family that will aid and defend me: so accord. to Yaakoob: or, as some say, I am their honoured little palm-tree &c. (TA. [See 2.]) [It is part of a prov., for which see جِذْلُ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
